intent: A compact grid face that opens a popover to edit column and row tracks — the Figma-style dimensions picker, not a second Inspector section or dialog.
guidance: Sits inline in a grid frame's inspector as a compact face, not a section or dialog. Fully controlled: onChange emits track patches, and onAddTrack only signals creation intent; the host owns durable track IDs and document mutation. Each track is Fixed (px value, animatable via a keyframe control) or Hug (shows "Auto", not animatable). Both axes cap at GRID_TRACK_LIMIT (6) tracks, and the last track can't be removed. The summary reads "{columns} × Auto" when every row hugs, else "{columns} × {rows}". The preview caps at 6 columns and 3 rows regardless of real counts, so the face stays glanceable.

anatomy.description: The 56×88 trigger button; a mini grid of cells previewing the column count and (capped) row count.
"{columns} × {Auto | rows}" centered over the face; reads "Auto" when every row track hugs.
Floating Menu opened on click; stacks the Columns and Rows groups. Not a second section/dialog.
"Columns" label above the column track rows, with a trailing "Add column" button.
"Rows" label above the row track rows, with a trailing "Add row" button.
One per track inside a group: a sizing input plus a Remove (−) button (disabled at the last remaining track).
NumericComboInput per track: axis icon (Columns2/Rows2), px value, and a Fixed/Auto sizing-mode menu.

use_when: Editing a grid frame's column and row tracks inline in the inspector.
You want a compact Figma-style dimensions face that opens the track editor on click.
dont_use_when: You need a standalone panel section or dialog — this is a compact inline face by design.
The frame is auto-layout (1D flow), not Grid — use the flow and gap controls instead.

face.note: 56×88px face, 3px pad, 2px cell gap all hardcoded (h-[56px] w-[88px] p-[3px] gap:2)

cell.note: rounded-[2px] cell radius is hardcoded, not a radius token

a11y.role: Trigger is a native <button> (implicit role button); the popover body and each axis track list render role="group".
a11y.label: Trigger aria-label "Grid dimensions: {summary}" (e.g. "3 × Auto"); groups labelled "Grid dimensions", "Column tracks", "Row tracks".
a11y.controls: Per track: NumericComboInput ariaLabel "{axis} {n} size" + dropdownAriaLabel naming the Fixed/Hug mode; Remove and Add buttons carry explicit labels.
a11y.focus: Trigger shows a 2px border-selected-strong focus-visible ring.

code.example:
<GridDimensionsPicker
  grid={grid}
  keyframes={trackKeyframes}
  onChange={(patch) => setGrid({ ...grid, ...patch })}
  onAddTrack={(axis) => addTrack(axis)}
/>
